# Prompt

Proposed implementation plan for going live with Zest AI

Share any questions you and the team would have that will enable to you to help the client use our software to go live with our AI driven underwriting. 

Internal resources: 

* a customer success team that includes 

1. an account manager,
2. a data scientist, 
3. a backend software engineer (focused on deployment)

External resources:

* a credit bureau representative (can be used to source credit data),
* a representative from the bank's loan origination system, with whom we can get the customer live scoring with their algorithm.

Be sure to document any assumptions you’ve made along the way in creating the plan, and what resources you would consult for the actual answers.

This first chunk loads packages

```{r Setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(dtplyr)
library(data.table)
library(optiRum)
library(readxl)
```


Reads data from Excel spreadsheet
```{r}
app_orig <- readxl::read_xlsx("file.xlsx", sheet = 2)
perf_orig <- readxl::read_xlsx("file.xlsx",sheet = 3)

```


Initial clean on app
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
app_data <- app_orig %>% 
  filter(payment_amount_approved > 0,
         amount_approved > 0,
         num_payments * payment_amount_approved > amount_approved) %>% 
  mutate(status_is_approved = (status == "Approved"),
         email_duration = as_factor(email_duration),
         residence_duration = as_factor(residence_duration),
         bank_account_duration = as_factor(bank_account_duration),
         payment_frequency = as_factor(payment_frequency),
         annual_payments = case_when(payment_frequency == "Monthly" ~ 12,
                                    payment_frequency == "Bi-weekly" ~ 26.09,
                                    payment_frequency == "Semi-monthly" ~ 24,
                                    TRUE ~ 52.18),
         home_phone_type = as_factor(home_phone_type),
         other_phone_type = as_factor(other_phone_type),
         how_use_money = as_factor(how_use_money),
         imputed_period_rate = optiRum::RATE(nper = num_payments, pmt = 0 - payment_amount_approved, pv = amount_approved),
         implied_annual_rate = imputed_period_rate * annual_payments)




```


```{r}
perf_data <- perf_orig %>% 
  transmute(customer_id = substring(idLoan, 1, 10),
         customer_loan = substring(idLoan, 12, 13),
         is_good = (flgGood == "Good"))

```



```{r}
app_data %>%
  group_by()
  lm(formula = implied_annual_rate ~ raw_l2c_score + raw_FICO_retail) %>% 
  summary()

```


```{r}
app_data %>%
  mutate(app_month = floor_date(application_when, "months")) %>% 
  filter(raw_FICO_retail > 223) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = raw_FICO_retail, y = raw_l2c_score, color = implied_annual_rate, size = implied_annual_rate)) +
  geom_jitter()
  

```
